caption: The drawing features a horizontal landscape with a variety of animals, plants, and trees, rendered in colored pencil or embroidery-like texture. On the left side, there is a brown stag with antlers and a white underbelly leaping to the right. Below the stag, a small white rabbit sits near a blue flower. To the right of the stag, a large green-leaved tree stands, with several other similarly styled trees and bushes scattered throughout the scene. Near the center and right, there are several large yellow flowers with long green stems and leaves. The midsection contains a few small, rounded, green shrubs and a pair of slender, pointed trees. Toward the right, two white dogs with red markings and collars are depicted running toward the right, followed by another white rabbit seated near three red circular fruits with stems. At the far right, a blue rabbit faces left. Above the animals and plants, in the upper center, a small red and yellow bird with outstretched wings flies towards the right. The background is a pale tan shade, while the ground is a strip of green with darker green at the edges, suggesting grass. The composition is balanced horizontally with elements distributed evenly, and the style is flat with limited shading.
title: Embroidered Petticoat Border
